The one does-not-compose room, picturegame, loses 0.28 to particulars (11 of its 24 lines its ordinary game relay or layers) and 0.04 to the reader. Unsupported claims were not tested against the raw record here (the quote check at E1b-01 is the run's one touch of it), a limit.

E1d the composition verdict, written in audit-E1.md: composition_status: unresolved. Level: the method question's, at prior.md section 3's three levels; supported at the population level (630 of 705 compose and 56 with residue at the re-check, none fails; expectations 0.924 in-sample; the spine's order counts beat their nulls); at the forms the population compiles in Kozlowski and Klein's sense, with shared adequacy in 2 of 35 branches (F09, F32); at the leaf the shared account holds in the reconstruction (fidelity 0.871, 0 contradicted, 7 of 200 lines read pointing at it) but local adequacy is not established. Why unresolved: prior.md section 3's two grounds, local adequacy with validated adaptations and shared adequacy, are not established (the validated half of the local measure not computed; the manifest gives every room local status unresolved; 33 branches unresolved), and the same section bars calling exact local fit evidence of global composition by itself; no failure condition is met, and an insufficient record yields uncertainty. Scope: model 46384686 without the held proposals, in-sample throughout. The held proposals P05 and A11 are stated in full in the composition result.
